reference_sql:
WITH daily AS (
  -- one row per day with webshop orders
  SELECT order_date, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM sales
  WHERE store_code = 'WEB-01'
    AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
  GROUP BY order_date
), days AS (
  -- one row per day of March 2025
  SELECT c.cal_date AS order_date, COALESCE(d.revenue_eur, 0) AS revenue_eur
  FROM calendar c
  LEFT JOIN daily d ON d.order_date = c.cal_date
  WHERE c.cal_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
)
SELECT order_date, revenue_eur,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY order_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 7
       THEN ROUND(AVG(revenue_eur) OVER (ORDER BY order_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2)
  END AS avg_revenue_7d
FROM days

  WHERE c.cal_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
)
SELECT d.order_date, d.revenue_eur,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 7 THEN ROUND(AVG(p.revenue_eur), 2) END AS avg_revenue_7d

WITH days AS (
  SELECT CAST(d AS DATE) AS order_date
  FROM generate_series(DATE '2025-03-01', DATE '2025-03-31', INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS g(d)
), rev AS (
  SELECT order_date, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM sales
  WHERE store_code = 'WEB-01' AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
  GROUP BY order_date
), j AS (
  SELECT d.order_date, COALESCE(r.revenue_eur, 0) AS revenue_eur
  FROM days d LEFT JOIN rev r ON r.order_date = d.order_date
)
SELECT order_date, revenue_eur,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY order_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 7
    THEN ROUND(AVG(revenue_eur) OVER (ORDER BY order_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) END AS avg_revenue_7d
FROM j
